title: What Happens When You Press Enter?
subtitle: How ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini Really Work
runningPrompt: Write a short poem about the rain

episodes.title: What Really Happens When You Input to LLM Prompt?
episodes.question: What is the full journey from my prompt to the answer?
episodes.tryIt: Time how fast the first word appears
episodes.useIt: Why long chats get slower and costlier

episodes.title: How Did the Model Learn to Talk?
episodes.question: Where did the model's knowledge and manners come from?
episodes.tryIt: Ask about last week's news, with and without web search
episodes.useIt: Don't trust recent facts unless search is on

episodes.title: Tokenization: How Text Becomes Numbers
episodes.question: How does a computer read my words?
episodes.tryIt: Count the letters in strawberry; compare English and Hindi token counts
episodes.useIt: Write shorter prompts to save money on APIs

episodes.title: Embeddings: How Numbers Get Meaning
episodes.question: How does the model know rain is close to storm?
episodes.tryIt: A word-maths game: guess which words are closest
episodes.useIt: Search your notes by meaning, not keywords

episodes.title: Attention and Transformers: How the Model Reads Context
episodes.question: How does it understand the whole sentence, not just single words?
episodes.tryIt: A pause-and-guess quiz: what does it mean?
episodes.useIt: Put key instructions at the start or end of long prompts

episodes.title: Next-Token Prediction: How the Answer Is Written
episodes.question: How does it pick each word, and why does it sometimes make things up?
episodes.tryIt: Write the same poem at low and high creativity settings
episodes.useIt: Low temperature for facts, high for brainstorming

episodes.title: Beyond the Model: What ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini Add
episodes.question: Why is a chat app more than just the model?
episodes.tryIt: Tell it 'You are a pirate' and watch its personality change
